timeline.summary: RateGain partnered with Easebuzz as a Gold Partner for RG Pay to offer localized payment solutions in India.
RateGain Travel Technologies reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹637.81 Cr and PAT of ₹117.25 Cr.
RateGain reported Q4FY26 operating revenue of ₹715.5 Cr and adjusted EBITDA of ₹167.9 Cr, driven by the Sojern acquisition integration.
Rategain Travel Technologies Limited held an earnings conference call on May 21, 2026, at 04:30 p.m. IST to discuss FY2025-26 financial and operational performance, with audio recording available.
RateGain released The APMEA Direct Booking Friction Report 2026 on May 29, 2026.
RateGain partnered with BoxPay on June 4, 2026, to integrate payment orchestration and AI-driven reconciliation into RG Pay.
